story.title: Story 4: Size Guidance, Retry, And Escalation

result.planSummary: Implemented size-guided lower-band retries with band-specific acceptance ranges, richer retry context passed into the compression provider, third-attempt escalation to GPT-5.5 medium with first-response acceptance, and regression coverage proving semantic lower-band accounting stays tied to persisted lower-band text.

changedFiles.reason: Added detailed/brief size-range checks, retry context propagation, third-attempt escalation, and acceptance of the final escalated response without persisting retry metadata on artifacts.
Expanded provider prompt construction so retry attempts include previous attempt details, target range guidance, landing feedback, and prior output text when available.
Added Story 4 coverage for detailed and brief size-guided retries, third-attempt escalation, and acceptance of an out-of-range escalated response.
Adjusted async-maintenance lower-band scheduling expectations so broader maintenance coverage remains valid under the new size-guided retry policy.
Added regression coverage proving semantic lower-band counters prefer persisted semantic artifact text over placeholder text.
Added regression coverage proving provider-input counting for lower-band artifacts reads persisted semantic artifact text.

findingsFixed: Implemented deterministic detailed 15%-50% and brief 1%-20% size checks with retry context carrying previous output, accepted range, and below/above-range landing feedback.
Implemented third-attempt escalation to GPT-5.5 medium and accepted the escalated response without storing routing or retry metadata on chunk artifacts.
Added regression coverage to keep semantic lower-band token accounting sourced from persisted lower-band text rather than placeholder text.

result.recommendedNextStep: Hand this story to verification with focus on the new size-guided retry loop, provider retry-context prompt content, and third-attempt escalation behavior.
